name: pregador-pro-webapp
description: Pregador Pro - Plataforma Homilética Web Nativa (PWA Offline-First)

scripts.dev: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),{exec}=require('child_process');const root=path.join(__dirname,'webapp'),port=process.env.PORT||8080,mimes={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.js':'application/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json; charset=utf-8','.png':'image/png','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.ico':'image/x-icon','.mobileconfig':'application/x-apple-aspen-config'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{let u=decodeURIComponent(req.url.split('?')[0].split('#')[0]);if(u.startsWith('/App_Pregador/'))u='/'+u.slice(14);else if(u==='/App_Pregador'||u==='/')u='/index.html';const fp=path.join(root,u);if(!fp.startsWith(root)){res.writeHead(403);return res.end();}fs.readFile(fp,(err,data)=>{if(err){fs.readFile(path.join(root,'index.html'),(e2,d2)=>{if(e2){res.writeHead(404);return res.end('Not found');}res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mimes['.html'],'Cache-Control':'no-store'});res.end(d2);});return;}const ext=path.extname(fp).toLowerCase();res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mimes[ext]||'application/octet-stream','Cache-Control':'no-store'});res.end(data);});}).listen(port,'0.0.0.0',()=>{console.log('\n============================================================');console.log('  PREGADOR PRO (WEB NATIVO) RODANDO EM: http://localhost:'+port);console.log('============================================================\n');exec('start http://localhost:'+port);});"
